shell_commands: find src/transport -type f -name "*.ts" | grep -v test | sort

npx prettier --write src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts src/transport/createServer.ts src/transport/sessionResume.test.ts src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts src/transport/ws/validation.test.ts src/transport/wsTestSupport.ts 2>&1

git add -A && git commit -m "$(cat <<'EOF'
feat(transport): deliver conversation list over WebSocket

Add support for list_sessions frames to deliver a user's conversation list
over WebSocket. Implement handler that calls sessionStore.listFor with user id
and options, converts Date objects to ISO strings for wire format, and returns
error frames when listFor is unavailable or throws.

Extract common test utilities (eventually, cleanupEngines, delegatingTo) to
wsTestSupport to reduce code duplication between acceptance test suites.

Fixes linting issues and ensures all list_sessions validation tests pass.
EOF
)"
git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main
